entries.definition: A short note on the story map, such as a moment or a goal, that is not a script or a conversation.
One timeline branch. Items tagged with a route belong only to that path through the story.
A condition on a story-map arrow. The way on opens only when the variables fit.
A named value the story remembers: a flag, a number or text.
How much the gatekeeper believes Wren; a number that grows with every favour.
The village where the story takes place.
